# ISO 9660 test images

Generated by `scripts/make-iso9660-fixtures.sh` with xorriso 1.5.6 (run in
WSL on the Windows lab host), gzipped. Same tree in each; only the name
extensions differ:

| File | Names | Reader |
|---|---|---|
| `rr-joliet.iso.gz` | Rock Ridge and Joliet (`-R -J -joliet-long`), as Linux media | Rock Ridge |
| `joliet.iso.gz` | Joliet only (`-J -joliet-long`) | Joliet |
| `plain.iso.gz` | neither (ISO level 1: 8.3 upper case) | plain |

Tree:

```
EFI/BOOT/BOOTX64.EFI          "not really a boot manager"
empty.txt                     0 bytes
Deep/a/b/c/d/leaf.txt         "leaf"
.disk/info                    an Ubuntu 26.04.1 .disk/info line
casper/vmlinuz, casper/initrd "kernel", "initrd"
sources/Ünïcode-文件.txt       "unicode name"
sources/big.bin               200 KiB + 5 bytes, byte i = (i*7) mod 256
sources/sxs/file-000.cab ...  150 files, content "0".."149" (multi-block directory)
sources/link-to-empty         symlink to ../empty.txt (Rock Ridge only)
long-name-…(×20).txt          "long": a Rock Ridge name needing a CE area
```

Multi-extent files are built in memory by the tests (a real one needs a
file over 4 GiB).
